Description.Name: Basic Attack: Kazahana
Description.Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Unleashes up to 5 slashes ahead, the first two deal <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>, and the last three deal <color=#98EFF0>Frost DMG</color>.

Description.Name: Basic Attack: Shimotsuki
Description.Desc:
While possessing <color=#FFFFFF>Fallen Frost</color>, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> or <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Hoshimi Miyabi sheathes her blade, entering the <color=#FFFFFF>$$$Shimotsuki$$$ stance</color> and begins charging. For each level of charge completed, 1 point of <color=#FFFFFF>Fallen Frost</color> is consumed, up to a maximum charge level of three.
When <color=#FFFFFF>Fallen Frost</color> is completely consumed, or when releasing <IconMap:Icon_Normal> or <IconMap:Icon_Special>, Hoshimi Miyabi executes a powerful blade draw and slash ahead, dealing massive <color=#98EFF0>Frost DMG</color> plus 3%/{EXCEL:1}%/{EXCEL:2}% of Hoshimi Miyabi's ATK as additional DMG based on her charge level. After this slash, she exits <color=#FFFFFF>$$$Shimotsuki$$$ stance</color>.
When <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack $$$Shimotsuki$$$</color> hits an enemy, it applies <color=#FFFFFF>Icefire</color> to the target, causing the target to take Ice DMG equal to {EXCEL:3}% of Hoshimi Miyabi's ATK every second and increasing the Anomaly Buildup of all squad members against the target by {EXCEL:4}%, lasting {EXCEL:5}s.
Upon entering the battlefield, Hoshimi Miyabi immediately gains {EXCEL:6} points of <color=#FFFFFF>Fallen Frost</color>.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased during the $$$Shimotsuki$$$ stance. Character is invulnerable during the third charge level slash.

Description.Name: Dodge: Mizutori
Description.Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Repeatedly press or hold <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
A dash dodge that covers a lot of ground.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Description.Name: Dash Attack: Fuyubachi
Description.Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a dodge to activate:
Slashes enemies in front, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.

Description.Name: Dodge Counter: Kan Suzume
Description.Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to activate:
Slashes enemies in front, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Frost DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Description.Name: Special Attack: Miyuki
Description.Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Quickly draws her blade and slashes ahead, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Frost DMG</color>.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

Description.Name: EX Special Attack: Fubuki
Description.Desc:
With enough Energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Rush forward, unleashing powerful slashes against enemies along the way, dealing massive <color=#98EFF0>Frost DMG</color>.
Upon activating this skill, gain 1 point of <color=#FFFFFF>Fallen Frost</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After using this skill, with enough Energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> again to consume extra Energy and unleash a powerful follow-up attack against enemies in front, dealing massive <color=#98EFF0>Frost DMG</color>.
Upon activating this skill, gain 1 point of <color=#FFFFFF>Fallen Frost</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill

Description.Name: Chain Attack: Haru Kitaru
Description.Desc:
When a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleashes a powerful slash at enemies in front in a large area, dealing massive <color=#98EFF0>Frost DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Description.Name: Ultimate: Nagori Yuki
Description.Desc:
When Decibel Rating is at <color=#FFFFFF>Maximum</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
Unleashes a powerful slash at enemies in front in a large area, dealing massive <color=#98EFF0>Frost DMG</color> plus 3% of Hoshimi Miyabi's ATK as additional DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Description.Name: Quick Assist: Kashin-Fuu
Description.Desc:
When the on-field character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Slashes enemies in front, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Frost DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Description.Name: Defensive Assist: Hanaikada
Description.Desc:
When the character on the field is about to be attacked, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate.
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Description.Name: Assist Follow-Up: Falling Blossom
Description.Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> to activate:
Charges and slashes enemies in front, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Frost DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

1091006.Name: EX Special Attack: Hanabira Yuki — Maximum

Name: Core Passive: Searing Cold
Additional Ability: Bask in Frost
Desc:
As Hoshimi Miyabi accumulates <color=#98EFF0>Frost Anomaly Buildup</color>, it has a unique and separate Anomaly Buildup gauge and triggers special <color=#98EFF0>Freeze</color>, <color=#98EFF0>Shatter</color>, and <color=#98EFF0>Frostbite</color> effects. The special <color=#98EFF0>Freeze</color>, <color=#98EFF0>Shatter</color>, and <color=#98EFF0>Frostbite</color> effects can be used in conjunction with other Anomaly effects to deal <color=#FFFFFF>Disorder</color>, including <color=#98EFF0>Ice Anomaly</color> effects.
In addition, when Hoshimi Miyabi applies her special <color=#98EFF0>Frostbite</color> effect to enemies under <color=#FFFFFF>Icefire</color>, it will consume the <color=#FFFFFF>Icefire</color> to trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Frostburn - Break</color> and deal <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color> equal to <color=#2BAD00>90%</color> of Hoshimi Miyabi's ATK to the target. At the same time, the target will enter the <color=#FFFFFF>Frostburn</color> state, increasing the Anomaly Buildup accumulated by all squad members against the target, lasting up until the current <color=#98EFF0>Frostburn</color> effect ends.
While enemies are under <color=#FFFFFF>Frostburn</color>, they cannot be inflicted with <color=#FFFFFF>Icefire</color>.

When another character in your squad is an <color=#FFFFFF>Anomaly</color> character or shares the same Faction:
When any squad member triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Disorder</color>, Hoshimi Miyabi gains 1 point of <color=#FFFFFF>Fallen Frost</color> and the next time she unleashes <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: $$$Shimotsuki$$$</color> while under <color=#FFFFFF>$$$Shimotsuki$$$ stance</color>, the skill's DMG increases by 50%.

1.Name: Frost Atop the Snow
1.Desc: <color=#FFFFFF>Frostburn - Break</color>'s DMG increases by 6% and applies <color=#FFFFFF>Deep Freeze</color> to enemies hit for 15s. While this effect is active, the target receives 10% more Anomaly DMG.

2.Name: Kunretsu
2.Desc: Hoshimi Miyabi becomes invulnerable during the <color=#FFFFFF>$$$Shimotsuki$$$ Stance</color> and for every 1 point of <color=#FFFFFF>Fallen Frost</color> consumed when charging up, her PEN Ratio increases by 6% when she next uses <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: $$$Shimotsuki$$$</color>, stacking up to 3 times. The effect ends when she leaves <color=#FFFFFF>$$$Shimotsuki$$$ Stance</color>. The number of <color=#FFFFFF>Fallen Frost</color> she gains when she enters the battlefield increases to 15 points.

3.Name: Martial Discipline
3.Desc2: Miyabi, coming from a martial family, has excellent training habits. Her commitment to swordsmanship practice is unwavering. What? A meeting? She won't be going.

4.Name: Breath Technique
4.Desc: When <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: $$$Kazahana$$$</color> hits an enemy under <color=#FFFFFF>Icefire</color>, each hit of the Basic Attack deals additional DMG equal to 15% of Hoshimi Miyabi's ATK. At the end of the 5th hit, she gains 1 point of <color=#FFFFFF>Fallen Frost</color>.

6.Name: Prodigious Talent
6.Desc:
When Hoshimi Miyabi eters <color=#FFFFFF>$$$Shimotsuki$$$ Stance</color>, gain the <color=#FFFFFF>Polar</color> effect. Under this effect, the DMG of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: $$$Shimotsuki$$$</color> increases by 30%.
Upon consuming <color=#FFFFFF>Fallen Frost</color> and completing the current level of charge, if <color=#FFFFFF>Fallen Frost</color> has not been completely depleted, immediately unleash the slash for the current charge level while increasing charge level by one. At most three blade draw and slashes can be performed in a single instance of <color=#FFFFFF>Polar</color>.
<color=#FFFFFF>Polar</color> ends upon leaving the <color=#FFFFFF>$$$Shimotsuki$$$ Stance</color>.
